package.name: g1_motion_service_sim
package.description: SIM-ONLY stand-in for the G1's onboard motion service. unitree_mujoco emulates only the low-level device, so nothing serves the weight-blended /arm_sdk interface, nothing answers /api/sport/* and nothing commands the legs. This node fills all three gaps, sim-side only: it blends /arm_sdk onto /lowcmd, answers the LocoClient wire protocol, and runs the RL walking policy that balances the robot. Launched exclusively by g1_bringup's sim.launch.py. See README.
